Get the latest aerial drone ground report of the ₹3,064.45 Crore New JP Setu Project (Digha–Sonepur Six-Lane Ganga Bridge) in Patna, Bihar.
In this video, we bring you the latest construction update of this prestigious infrastructure project across the River Ganga, covering the Southern End Interchange in Patna, the main bridge construction and the Northern End Viaduct towards Sonepur.
Project Details
Project Name: New Digha–Sonepur Six-Lane Ganga Bridge
Location: Patna and Saran District, Bihar
Main Bridge Length: 4.556 km
Total Project Length: Approximately 6.895 km, including approaches
